title: Digital Infrastructure Grant
description: Supports access to digital infrastructure, broadband connectivity, and community technology access programs.

title: Workforce Innovation Grant
description: Funds job training, skills development, and workforce readiness programs aligned with emerging digital economy sectors.

title: Civic Technology Grant
description: Supports development and implementation of public digital systems, transparency tools, and civic engagement technologies.

title: Digital Equity Initiative
description: Advances equitable access to digital resources, digital literacy programs, and technology adoption in underserved communities.

title: Public Financial Transparency Grant
description: Supports implementation of financial transparency systems, open data initiatives, and accountability reporting infrastructure.

title: Community Capacity Building Grant
description: Invests in organizational capacity, staff training, and program development for community-serving institutions.
